text: On their horse ranch in Agua Dulce, California, siblings OJ and Em Haywood lose their father to [a nickel falling out of the sky|trigger|losing family]. Six months later the power flickers, the horses panic and animals vanish into [a cloud in the valley that never moves|images|weather, sky and darkness]. Broke and stubborn, the pair set out to [catch the thing on camera|images|pictures, screens and recordings] and sell the shot, while a former child star at a nearby Western theme park [feeds it their horses for a live show|wrong|exploitation for profit].
